findings.title: group.users.delete(user_id) passes an integer to an AR collection
findings.body: `remove_member` calls `group.users.delete(user_id)` where `user_id` is an Integer. ActiveRecord collection `delete` expects record objects (or at least responds unpredictably to raw ids, raising NoMethodError on `id`/`destroyed?` in many versions). The member will not be removed, or the request will 500. It should look up the user (`user = User.find_by(id: user_id)`) and call `group.remove(user)` / `group.users.delete(user)`, and return a 404/422 if the user isn't found.

findings.title: update silently clears `visible` and never persists alias_level on create
findings.body: In `update`, `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"` unconditionally, so any PUT that omits `visible` (e.g. a partial update from a future client or an API caller) flips the group to not-visible. Additionally `create` only reads `name` and `visible`, so the `alias_level` the client sends in `asJSON()` on group creation is dropped, and new groups always get the default alias level. Use `params.key?(:visible)` guards and handle `alias_level` in `create`.

findings.title: totalPages off-by-one for exact multiples of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` is `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. With user_count=50 and limit=50 this yields 2 pages, the second of which is empty; the 'next' arrow stays enabled and `showingLast` never matches on the real last page. Use `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` instead.

findings.title: Offset clamped to user_count yields an empty last page
findings.body: `offset = Math.min(user_count, Math.max(offset, 0))` allows offset == user_count, which requests a range past the last member and returns zero members. The upper clamp should be `Math.max(user_count - limit, 0)`.

findings.title: `{{each}}` used with block-param syntax but no closing tag
findings.body: `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` mixes the keyword (`x in y`) form, which requires a block and `{{/each}}`, with the inline `itemView` form. As written the template will either fail to compile or render nothing, so the member list never appears on the admin group page.

findings.title: Unbounded `limit` param on public members endpoint
findings.body: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` is not capped, and this endpoint is public (only subject to group visibility). A caller can pass `limit=1000000` and force serialization of every group member, a cheap way to generate heavy DB/CPU load. Clamp limit to a sane maximum (e.g. 50–200) and reject negative values.

findings.title: remove_member test uses PUT while the route only accepts DELETE, and relies on hardcoded group id 1
findings.body: The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' example issues `xhr :put, :remove_member`, but config/routes.rb maps only `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"`. Controller specs bypass routing, so this passes while the real verb mapping is untested. Both this test and the add_members/update tests also assume group id 1 exists and is automatic, which depends on seed data rather than fabricated fixtures. Fabricate an automatic group and use the correct verb.

findings.title: addMembers/removeMember failures are silently swallowed
findings.body: `addMembers` and `removeMember` call into the model without attaching a rejection handler, so a server error (e.g. 422 for an automatic group, or an unknown username) produces no user feedback and the input is never cleared (per the TODO). Add an error handler that surfaces the response errors via bootbox like `save` does.
